text_block_list.name: Kasumi
text_block_list.text: We're just a few steps away from solving this case, I'd say.
text_block_list.orig_text:
馬車レースもこの事件も、
いよいよ大詰めというわけだね。

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text:
Th-this is all to protect {0}!
I won't let up until it's over.
text_block_list.orig_text:
せ、
先輩を守る為なら、
私は最後まで頑張っちゃいますよ！

text_block_list.name: Kasumi
text_block_list.text:
Someone sure is motivated.
I guess you just can't beat a girl in love, can you? ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
凄い気合いだ……
やっぱり、
恋する乙女は無敵だね♪

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I'm a girl in lo—
W-wait! What are you making me say?!
I-it's not like that. I just, um, admire him? Worship him?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい！
　恋する乙女は……
って、
な、
ななな、
なにを言わせるんですかぁ……！
先輩は、
その……
憧れというか……
崇拝というか……

text_block_list.name: Kasumi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah. Let's leave it at that. ♪
Now then. Let's see this through to the end, shall we?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はいはい、
そういう事にしておくよ♪
さて、
最後まで気を抜かずにいくとしようか！
